title: Nimbrella Steals the Rain
story: A jellyfish-shaped sky creature named Nimbrella drifts over the Farrow Valley and sips the rain right out of the clouds before it can fall. The farmers' reservoir is drying, and Mr 6 floats up on a kite to negotiate. Nimbrella agrees to give back water — if the knight can say exactly how much is left.
question: The reservoir held 840 barrels of water. Nimbrella siphoned away 1/4 of it on Monday, then 1/3 of what REMAINED on Tuesday. How many barrels are left?
hint: Find what's left after Monday first — that's the amount Tuesday's fraction applies to.
victory: Mr 6 named 420 without blinking, and Nimbrella, impressed, burped every drop back in a warm summer downpour. The farmers danced; Mr 6's cape took two days to dry.
imagePrompt: A translucent jellyfish-shaped cloud creature siphoning silver rain above a half-empty stone reservoir, with a numeral-6 knight riding a kite in a pale windy sky.
